question.prompt: Each time a sheet of paper is folded in half, the number of layers becomes 2 times as large. After 1 fold, there are 2 layers. How many layers are there after 4 folds?

solutions.explanation: Starting from 2 layers after the first fold, the remaining three folds each double the layer count, giving \(2\times2\times2\times2=16\). After 4 folds, there are 16 layers.
solutions.title: Three more doublings
